How it works

Security work, end to end

HackersDeal is a cybersecurity-native marketplace — not a generic freelance board. Every flow is built for pentests, assessments, and coordinated disclosure.

  1. Step 1

    Post a scoped security project

    Define assets, in/out of scope, testing windows, and budget. Publish publicly or keep the engagement private.

  2. Step 2

    Receive qualified bids

    Researchers and pentesters submit proposals with pricing and timelines. Compare reputation and valid report history.

  3. Step 3

    Collaborate in a secure workspace

    Chat, share evidence, deliver structured findings, and fund milestones through escrow-backed payments.

  4. Step 4

    Validate and pay with confidence

    Triage reports, release escrow when satisfied, and build long-term trust with vetted security talent.
